420:t_029:13.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$ハイアデス$$ has been traveling across the galaxy in search of battle...」

420:t_029:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I heard we could have even more fun battles if we joined $$サイデリアル$$, and it looks like that's finally coming true.」

420:t_029:15.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Guys! Are You Ready!」

420:t_029:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「These guys...! Do they think war is a game!?」

420:t_029:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「Getting angry is a waste of energy, $$カミーユ$$. Their mental makeup is nothing like ours.」

420:t_029:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The greedy golden bull... The source of that power seems to lie in desire.」

420:t_029:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hahahaha, $$ストラウス$$! So you've shed your armor!」

420:t_029:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Can't be helped. It broke, you know.」

420:t_029:25.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know. I'm not reckless enough to stay on your battlefield.」

420:t_029:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It was worth coming all this way.」

420:t_029:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... Next time, I'll bring $$西条涼音$$ to you, just as you wished.」

420:t_029:29.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Though I make no promises about what condition she'll be in.」

420:t_029:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've served me well up to today.」

420:t_029:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As your reward, I shall release the hatred inside you.」

420:t_030:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's that guy going to do!?」

420:t_030:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He said he'd release the hatred, but...」

420:t_030:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The aura coming off $$ギルター$$...!」

420:t_030:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! Everyone who insults me will die!!」

420:t_030:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Fine hatred, $$ギルター$$. Raising you was worth the trouble after all.」

420:t_030:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Putting you, a lump of inferiority complex and jealousy, under $$サルディアス$$ was exactly the right way to raise you.」

420:t_030:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You amplified the hatred of your own subordinate $$ギルター$$ and destroyed his mind!」

420:t_030:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That guy...! He pulled that trick again!」

420:t_030:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I leave the rest to you, $$ギルター$$. ...Though even if you defeat $c, you have no future.」

420:t_030:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get cocky, $n. Your awakening is still unstable.」

420:t_030:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「With the slightest trigger, the backlash will kill your mind... Can you endure that?」

420:t_030:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I look forward to meeting you again, $c! Next time, I'll invite Miss $$スズネ$$, whom you all love so much!」

420:t_031:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Yeah, yeah. No point chasing a scorpion that's run away.」

420:t_032:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「From here on, you're playing with me! Let's Enjoy Party!!」

420:t_032:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly! And I think Darling, who can take on my fights, is the best partner there is.」

420:t_032:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling is Darling, so why shouldn't I call Darling 'Darling'?」

420:t_032:5.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm the only one who gets to call Darling 'Darling'!」

420:t_032:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Meanie! Fine, then! I'll take him by force!」

420:t_032:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「She may look like she's fooling around, but the pressure is way bigger than in her armor form!」

420:t_032:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So with the armor blown off, her desire is at full blast too!」

420:t_032:9.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$エルーナ$$! Ignore a man like that and give the order to advance at once!」

420:t_032:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What is it, $$ダバラーン$$? Jealous?」

420:t_032:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I-I am your loyal right hand, $$エルーナ$$! S-such an improper thing...!」

420:t_032:12.en:
$$赤木$$
(So that guy's devotion wasn't loyalty after all...!)

420:t_032:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Okay, $$ギルター$$! You have fun too!」

420:t_032:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aww... once a human gets like that, they're finished...」

420:t_032:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I guess I ought to at least apologize to $$アウストラリス$$. I can fight for about three minutes.」

420:t_032:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Warriors of $$ハイアデス$$! $$エルーナ$$'s orders have been given! In these 3 minutes, we will wipe out $c!」

420:t_033:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Try it if you can, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

420:t_033:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... Let's have plenty of fun, Darling!」

420:t_034:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! The general with the greatest strategic mind in $$サイデリアル$$, the man worthy of deputy commander of $$アンタレス$$!」

420:t_034:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All you worthless fools, bow down before me! $$サルディアス$$, $$バルビエル$$, even Emperor $$アウストラリス$$!」

420:t_035:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did he break free of $$バルビエル$$'s control when faced with death...」

420:t_035:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no...! I don't want to die! I...!」

420:t_036:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aww... if he'd just stayed alive, he could've enjoyed fighting even more...」

420:t_036:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Kinda lost my mood. Let's go home for today.」

420:t_036:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't be so eager. Next time let's enjoy an even more fiery fight.」

kept_omissions: 420:t_030:1: He said he'd release the hatred - subject kept as 'He' (Barbiel, from his preceding line)
uncertain: 420:t_029:22/t_032:17: ストラウス used as Barbiel's address for Elunaluna (token $$ストラウス$$); apology to アウストラリス taken as the Emperor
